khattabka_: Quentin Khattabka came up on Day 4 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Quentin Khattabka was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin Khattabka. Quentin Khattabka read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Quentin Khattabka in the open at S-F3. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Cyril "Ash" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Quentin Khattabka was carried in at last. The worst has passed for Quentin Khattabka. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
lord_punchworth: Karel Punchworth unpacked a tin of tobacco at R-F22. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Karel Punchworth tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F22 is up. A letter from home found Karel Punchworth before the night shift. Karel Punchworth folded it small and kept it close.
miked8903: The quartermaster asked Jonas Miked to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Jonas Miked helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Jonas Miked and Nils Makinekivanc carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
A bullet found Jonas Miked at R-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Severin Sky of the Hegemony (@the_ghost_of_sky).
Jonas Miked drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
